synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateConfig.description:
AggregateConfig defines aggregate comparison settings.
 Used when mode is AGGREGATE to compare grouped measures between source and target.

group_columns.description:
Single column: flat GROUP BY comparison.
   group_columns: ["region"]
   → GROUP BY region

 Multiple columns: cumulative GROUP BY drill-down, pruning matched groups
 at each level to focus on divergent branches.
   group_columns: ["region", "city", "store"]
   → Level 0: GROUP BY region
   → Level 1: GROUP BY region, city  (only for mismatched regions)
   → Level 2: GROUP BY region, city, store (only for mismatched cities)
group_columns.title:
Columns defining the drill-down hierarchy for aggregate comparison.
 Falls back to key_column if not set.

measures.description:
Measures to compare between source and target.
 Each measure defines a column and one or more aggregate functions to apply.

thresholds.description:
Tolerance thresholds for aggregate comparisons.
 When not set, exact match is required for all measures.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateConfig.title: Aggregate Config

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateDrillChild.description: AggregateDrillChild represents a single divergent group within a drill-down level.

differences.description: All difference variants computed for this group.

drill_down.description: Further drill-down into this divergent group.

threshold_evaluation.description: Threshold evaluation results for this group.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateDrillChild.title: Aggregate Drill Child

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateDrillNode.description: AggregateDrillNode represents a node in the hierarchical aggregate drill-down tree.

group_column.description: Group column used at this level.

matched_groups.description: Number of matched groups at this level.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateDrillNode.title: Aggregate Drill Node

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateStageResult.description: AggregateStageResult is the result for an aggregate_check stage.

divergent_groups.description:
Top-level groups that diverged (counterpart of matched_groups, same level as
 total_groups). This is the same-level numerator for a "divergent_groups of
 total_groups diverged" summary — unlike the leaf-level mismatch_groups /
 missing_* counts above, which can exceed total_groups in a multi-level drill.

drill_down.description: Hierarchical drill-down tree for aggregate comparison.

early_termination_reason.description: Reason if aggregate check terminated early.

matched_groups.description:
Top-level groups that matched — directly, or because their whole subtree
 resolved. Same level as total_groups.

mismatch_groups.description:
Leaf-level groups with value differences (deepest drill level). NOT
 comparable to total_groups: one divergent top-level group can contain many
 divergent leaves. For a same-level "X of Y diverged" ratio use
 divergent_groups / total_groups; use these leaf counts for detail.

missing_source.description: Leaf-level groups present in target but missing in source.

missing_target.description: Leaf-level groups present in source but missing in target.

total_groups.description:
Top-level (first group column) total group count. With a multi-level
 drill-down this is the number of distinct first-level groups, NOT the number
 of leaf groups. Invariant: total_groups == matched_groups + divergent_groups.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AggregateStageResult.title: Aggregate Stage Result

synq.agent.recon.v1.AuditLog.description:
AuditLog is the root structure for a reconciliation run audit.
 It captures all operations performed during a synq-recon reconciliation run.

config_file.description: Path to the configuration file used.

environment.description:
Name of the environment used for this run.
 Empty for direct/unmanaged runs where no environment was applied.

meta.description: Build and environment metadata for the synq-recon binary.

parent_invocation_id.description:
Invocation ID of the parent run this continues from.
 Set when this run resumes or drills deeper into a previous run's results.

reconciliations.description: Audit records for each reconciliation executed.

resolved_table_references.description:
Effective table references after environment overrides were applied.
 Keyed by "reconciliation_name.source" or "reconciliation_name.target".
 Only populated when an environment was active and overrides were applied.
 The suite field (14) still contains the original pre-override config.

resolved_variables.description:
Resolved template variable values used for query interpolation.
 Contains the actual values after template evaluation
 (e.g. "{{today - 30d}}" resolved to "2026-01-27").

status.description: Overall execution status derived from individual reconciliation outcomes.
status.title: Audit Status

suite.description:
Full suite configuration snapshot as executed.
 Contains all reconciliation definitions, variables, thresholds, etc.

summary.description: Aggregated counts derived from individual reconciliation results.

total_stats.description: Aggregated query execution statistics across all queries in this run.

warnings.description: Suite-level warnings detected during config validation.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AuditLog.title: Audit Log

synq.agent.recon.v1.AuditMeta.description: AuditMeta holds build and environment metadata for the synq-recon binary.

go_version.description: Go toolchain version used to build the binary.

vcs_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AuditMeta.title: Audit Meta

synq.agent.recon.v1.AuditSummary.description: AuditSummary holds aggregated counts derived from individual reconciliation results.

errors.description: Error messages collected from failed reconciliations.

failed.description: Number of reconciliations that encountered an infrastructure error.

matched.description: Number of reconciliations that completed and matched exactly.

matched_within_threshold.description:
Number of reconciliations that had differences within configured thresholds.
 These are warning-level outcomes — data differs but within acceptable tolerance.

mismatched.description:
Number of reconciliations that completed but found data differences
 exceeding thresholds (or no thresholds configured).

overall_match.description:
True when every reconciliation matched (exactly or within threshold).
 False when any reconciliation failed or had an exceeding mismatch.

synq.agent.recon.v1.AuditSummary.title: Audit Summary

synq.agent.recon.v1.BisectionConfig.description:
BisectionConfig controls the bisection drill-down algorithm that recursively
 splits the key range to locate individual mismatched rows.
 Only used in ROW_CHECKSUM mode.

enabled.description:
Whether bisection drill-down is enabled.
 When false, only the quick-check (count + checksum) runs — mismatches
 are detected but not localized to specific rows.

factor.description:
Branching factor: how many segments each level is split into.
 Higher values find mismatches faster (fewer levels) but issue more queries per level.
 Default: 32. Typical range: 4–64.

strategy.description: Segmentation strategy for splitting key ranges.
strategy.title: Segmentation Strategy

threshold.description:
Row count threshold: stop bisecting when a segment has fewer rows than this.
 Lower values find more precise mismatch locations but issue more queries.
 Default: 16384. Set to 1 to drill down to individual rows.

time_column.description:
Column for time-based partitioning. Required when strategy is TIME.
 Must be a timestamp, date, or datetime column in the dataset.

time_granularity.description:
Granularity for time-based segmentation. Default: DAY.
 Controls the width of each time bucket when strategy is TIME.
time_granularity.title: Time Granularity

synq.agent.recon.v1.BisectionConfig.title: Bisection Config

synq.agent.recon.v1.BisectionStageResult.description: BisectionStageResult is the result for a bisection_drill stage.

error_count.description: Number of segments that encountered errors.

investigation_queries.description: Merged investigation queries for adjacent mismatch regions.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth reached in the segment tree.

mismatch_leaves.description: Details for each mismatched leaf segment.

synq.agent.recon.v1.BisectionStageResult.title: Bisection Stage Result

synq.agent.recon.v1.BisectionStatistics.description: BisectionStatistics holds statistics about the bisection segment tree.

depth_distribution.description: Number of segments at each depth level.

mismatch_by_depth.description: Number of mismatched segments at each depth level.

synq.agent.recon.v1.BisectionStatistics.title: Bisection Statistics

synq.agent.recon.v1.ColumnMapping.description:
ColumnMapping maps a source column name to a target column name.
 Used when source and target use different naming conventions for the same data
 (e.g., snake_case vs SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, or completely different names).
 Only columns with different names need explicit mapping — columns with
 identical names (or case-insensitive matches when case_insensitive is true)
 are matched automatically.

source.description: Column name in the source dataset.

target.description: Corresponding column name in the target dataset.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ColumnMapping.title: Column Mapping

synq.agent.recon.v1.ColumnThresholdOverr.description:
ColumnThresholdOverride associates threshold overrides with a specific
 group_column level in the aggregate drill-down hierarchy.

column.description:
Group column name this override applies to.
 Must match one of the group_columns in the AggregateConfig.

thresholds.description:
Threshold overrides for this group column level.
 Values here override the parent ThresholdConfig for reconciliation groups
 at this drill-down level. May include per_measure for further specificity.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ColumnThresholdOverr.title: Column Threshold Override

synq.agent.recon.v1.ConnectionQueries.description:
ConnectionQueries associates SQL queries with a specific connection.
 Used for setup and teardown blocks at both suite and reconciliation level.

connection.description:
Connection name to execute these queries on.
 Must reference a connection configured in the runner's connection map.

queries.description: SQL queries to execute in order on this connection.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ConnectionQueries.title: Connection Queries

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffApplyConfig.description: CutoffApplyConfig controls how the resolved cutoff value is applied as a WHERE filter.

column.description: Column to filter on. When not set, uses the derivation column from that side.

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffApplyConfig.title: Cutoff Apply Config

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffConfig.description:
The cutoff is resolved at runtime before comparison queries run:
  1. Derive watermark(s) from source and/or target via aggregate queries.
  2. Combine them (default: MIN of both sides).
  3. Optionally truncate to a time boundary and apply an offset.
  4. Apply as WHERE filter to both source and target queries.

apply_source.description:
How to apply the cutoff as a WHERE filter on the source side.
 When not set, uses the source derivation column with <= operator.

apply_target.description:
How to apply the cutoff as a WHERE filter on the target side.
 When not set, uses the target derivation column with <= operator.

combine.description:
How to combine watermarks when both sides are configured.
 Default: MIN (use the smaller watermark for safety).
 Ignored when only one side has a watermark.
combine.title: Cutoff Combine

offset.description:
Time offset applied after truncation.
 Negative durations subtract from the cutoff (safety buffer).
 Example: "-30m" shifts the cutoff 30 minutes earlier.

source.description:
Per-side watermark derivation config for source.
 When not set, derives from target only.

target.description:
Per-side watermark derivation config for target.
 When not set, derives from source only.

truncate.description:
Truncate the combined watermark to a time boundary.
 Example: HOUR truncates 08:47:12 to 08:00:00.
 Applied after combining, before offset.
truncate.title: Cutoff Truncate

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffConfig.title:
CutoffConfig defines a dynamic cutoff filter for sync reconciliation.
 It derives a watermark value from the actual data (e.g., MAX(created_at))
 to automatically exclude rows that haven't been synced yet.

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffResult.description:
CutoffResult captures the runtime resolution of a cutoff filter.
 Stored in the audit log to provide full transparency into how the cutoff
 was derived and applied.

cutoff_value.description:
Final cutoff value after combining source/target watermarks
 and applying truncation and offset transforms.

source_watermark.description:
Watermark value derived from the source dataset.
 Empty when cutoff was configured for target-only derivation.

source_where.description: WHERE clause applied to the source query.

target_watermark.description:
Watermark value derived from the target dataset.
 Empty when cutoff was configured for source-only derivation.

target_where.description: WHERE clause applied to the target query.

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffResult.title: Cutoff Result

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffSideConfig.description:
There are two modes:
  1. Column + aggregate (default): auto-generates a watermark query from the dataset.
     For table-based datasets, queries the table directly (the column does NOT need
     to be in the reconciliation column list). For query-based datasets, wraps the
     query as a subquery (the column MUST be in the query's SELECT list).
  2. Custom query: provide a SQL query that returns a single row with a "watermark" column.
     Use this when the auto-generated query doesn't work (e.g., complex joins, custom logic).

 After resolution at runtime, the `query` field is always populated with the actual SQL
 that was executed, regardless of which mode was used. This ensures the audit log captures
 the exact query for reproducibility.

aggregate.description:
Aggregate function to derive the watermark. Default: MAX.
 Only used when query is not set.
aggregate.title: Cutoff Aggregate

column.description:
Column to derive the watermark from (e.g., "created_at", "synced_at").
 Required when query is not set.

query.description:
Custom SQL query for watermark derivation.
 Must return a single row with a "watermark" column.
 When not set, auto-generated from the dataset at runtime.
 After resolution, this field is populated with the actual query that was executed.

synq.agent.recon.v1.CutoffSideConfig.title: CutoffSideConfig configures watermark derivation for one side (source or target).

synq.agent.recon.v1.Dataset.description:
Dataset defines a source or target dataset for reconciliation.
 A dataset specifies which connection to use and how to select data —
 either via a raw SQL query or by referencing a table with optional column filtering.

as_of.description:
Time-travel timestamp for snapshot queries (e.g., "2026-02-01 00:00:00").
 When set, wraps the query with database-specific time-travel syntax:
   - Snowflake: AT(TIMESTAMP => '<as_of>')
   - BigQuery: FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP '<as_of>'
   - Databricks: TIMESTAMP AS OF '<as_of>'
 Has no effect on databases that don't support time-travel.

connection.description:
Name of the connection to use. Must reference a connection configured
 in the runner's connection map.

query.description:
Raw SQL query returning the dataset.
 Should be a SELECT or WITH (CTE) statement.
 Supports template variable interpolation via {{variable_name}} syntax.

table.description:
Table reference with optional column selection.
 Automatically generates a SELECT query from the table metadata.

synq.agent.recon.v1.Dataset.title: Dataset

synq.agent.recon.v1.DatasetInfo.description: DatasetInfo captures runtime information about a source or target dataset.

query.description: Resolved SQL query actually executed (after variable interpolation).

synq.agent.recon.v1.DatasetInfo.title: Dataset Info

synq.agent.recon.v1.DepthStats.description: DepthStats holds per-depth-level statistics for the bisection tree.
synq.agent.recon.v1.DepthStats.title: Depth Stats

synq.agent.recon.v1.DiffQueries.description: DiffQueries holds investigation queries for a mismatch leaf.

source_rows.description: SQL query to retrieve source rows in the mismatch segment.

target_rows.description: SQL query to retrieve target rows in the mismatch segment.

synq.agent.recon.v1.DiffQueries.title: Diff Queries

synq.agent.recon.v1.ErrorHandlingConfig.description:
ErrorHandlingConfig controls retry and timeout behavior for database queries.
 Applies to all queries within a reconciliation (setup, comparison, teardown).

max_retries.description:
Maximum retry attempts for transient query failures.
 The total number of attempts is max_retries + 1 (initial + retries).
 Default: 2.

query_timeout.description:
Per-query timeout. When a query exceeds this duration, it is cancelled.
 Default: no per-query limit (only the global run timeout applies).

retry_backoff_factor.description:
Backoff multiplier applied after each retry.
 Delay for attempt N = retry_initial_delay * retry_backoff_factor^(N-1).
 Must be >= 1.0 to ensure delays don't decrease.
 Default: 2.0.

retry_initial_delay.description:
Initial backoff delay before the first retry.
 Subsequent retries multiply this by retry_backoff_factor.
 Default: 1s.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ErrorHandlingConfig.title: Error Handling Config

synq.agent.recon.v1.InvestigationQuery.description:
InvestigationQuery represents a merged diff query covering one or more
 adjacent mismatch leaves.

leaves_covered.description: Number of mismatch leaves covered by this query.

source_query.description: SQL query to retrieve source rows.

target_query.description: SQL query to retrieve target rows.

synq.agent.recon.v1.InvestigationQuery.title: Investigation Query

synq.agent.recon.v1.Measure.description:
Measure defines a column and aggregate function(s) to compare
 between source and target datasets.
 A single measure with multiple functions expands into multiple comparisons
 (e.g., column="amount" functions=[SUM, AVG] produces "SUM(amount)" and "AVG(amount)").

column.description:
Column name to aggregate. Must exist in both source and target datasets
 (after column mapping is applied).

functions.description:
Aggregate functions to apply to this column.
 Multiple functions produce multiple measure comparisons from one column.

synq.agent.recon.v1.Measure.title: Measure

synq.agent.recon.v1.MeasureDifferences.description: MeasureDifferences holds all difference variants for measure comparisons.

relative.description: Relative difference per measure (target - source). Positive means target is larger.

synq.agent.recon.v1.MeasureDifferences.title: Measure Differences

synq.agent.recon.v1.MeasureThresholdOver.description:
MeasureThresholdOverride associates threshold overrides with a specific
 measure (aggregate function + column combination).

column.description:
Column name this override applies to.
 Together with function, forms the measure key (e.g., SUM + "amount" = "SUM(amount)").

function.description: Aggregate function this override applies to.
function.title: Aggregate Function

thresholds.description:
Threshold overrides for this specific measure.
 Values here override the parent ThresholdConfig (and any per_column override)
 for this measure only.

synq.agent.recon.v1.MeasureThresholdOver.title: Measure Threshold Override

synq.agent.recon.v1.MeasureVerdict.description: MeasureVerdict captures the threshold evaluation result for a single measure.

effective_absolute.description: Absolute threshold applied to this measure (may differ via per_measure config).

effective_percentage.description: Percentage threshold applied to this measure.

effective_percentage_mode.description: Percentage mode applied to this measure.

exceeded.description: True when the measure difference exceeds all configured thresholds.

reason.description: Explains why the measure was considered within or outside thresholds.
reason.title: Measure Verdict Reason

synq.agent.recon.v1.MeasureVerdict.title: Measure Verdict

synq.agent.recon.v1.MismatchLeafDetail.description: MismatchLeafDetail holds detailed information about a single mismatch leaf.

diff_queries.description: Investigation queries to inspect this mismatch.

row_mismatch_count.description: Total number of row mismatches (may exceed row_mismatches length due to sample_limit).

row_mismatches.description: Per-row mismatch details (when reporting level allows).

termination_reason.description: Why bisection stopped at this leaf.
termination_reason.title: Termination Reason

synq.agent.recon.v1.MismatchLeafDetail.title: Mismatch Leaf Detail

synq.agent.recon.v1.Normalization.description: Normalization records the column expressions used after cross-DB type alignment.
synq.agent.recon.v1.Normalization.title: Normalization

synq.agent.recon.v1.QueryRecord.description: QueryRecord captures a single SQL query execution.

error.description: Error message if the query failed.

id.description: Unique query identifier within this run.

retry_attempt.description: Retry attempt number (0 for first attempt).

role.description: Whether this query ran against source or target.
role.title: Query Role

stats.description: Execution statistics collected from the database driver.

synq.agent.recon.v1.QueryRecord.title: Query Record

synq.agent.recon.v1.QueryStats.description:
QueryStats holds execution statistics collected from the database driver.
 Fields are optional — absent means the metric is not available for the driver.

bytes_read.description: Number of bytes read/scanned by the query engine.

cache_hit.description: Whether the query result was served from cache.

query_id.description:
Database-assigned query identifier for auditing.
 Available for BigQuery (job ID), Snowflake, ClickHouse.

rows_produced.description: Number of result rows returned to the caller.

rows_read.description: Number of rows read/scanned by the query engine.

wall_time_millis.description: Wall time reported by the engine (Trino).

synq.agent.recon.v1.QueryStats.title: Query Stats

synq.agent.recon.v1.QuickCheckStageResul.description: QuickCheckStageResult is the result for a quick_check stage.
synq.agent.recon.v1.QuickCheckStageResul.title: Quick Check Stage Result

synq.agent.recon.v1.Reconcilation.description:
Reconcilation defines a single reconciliation scenario comparing data
 between a source and target dataset. Each reconciliation runs independently
 and produces its own pass/mismatch/fail result.

aggregate.description:
Aggregate comparison settings. Required when mode is AGGREGATE.
 Defines which measures to compare and tolerance thresholds.

annotations.description:
Case-level annotations. Merged with suite-level annotations and
 deployment-level annotations at promote time, then exposed on the
 case asset (PromotedReconCaseMetadata).

bisection.description:
Bisection drill-down configuration for ROW_CHECKSUM mode.
 Controls how the key range is recursively split to locate mismatches.
 When not set, uses sensible defaults (factor=32, threshold=16384).

case_insensitive.description:
When true, automatically matches columns differing only in letter case
 (e.g., user_id matches USER_ID). Defaults to true when not set.
 Set to false to require exact case matching.

column_mapping.description:
Explicit column name mapping between source and target.
 Only columns with different names need mapping — identical names
 (or case-insensitive matches) are matched automatically.

cutoff.description:
Dynamic cutoff filter for sync reconciliation.
 Derives a watermark from actual data to exclude rows not yet synced.
 Applied as WHERE filter to both source and target queries at runtime.

description.description: Optional longer description explaining what this reconciliation validates.

error_handling.description:
Error handling and retry configuration for database queries.
 Controls timeouts and retry behavior for transient failures.

hash_algorithm.description:
Hash algorithm for row checksums in ROW_CHECKSUM mode.
 When unset, auto-negotiates the best common algorithm between the
 source and target database dialects.
hash_algorithm.title: Hash Algorithm

ignore_setup_errors.description:
When true, logs setup errors as warnings and continues.
 When not set, inherits from suite-level ignore_setup_errors.

key_column.description:
Deprecated: use key_columns instead. Single primary key column used for
 ordering and segmentation during bisection. Retained for backward
 compatibility — existing single-key configs and stored audit logs keep
 working. When key_columns is set, this field is ignored. Readers should
 resolve the effective key via key_columns first, falling back to this.

key_columns.description:
Ordered list of key columns used for ordering and segmentation during
 bisection. Supports composite (multi-column) keys; the bisection orders and
 range-filters on the column tuple so the engine can prune via a matching
 primary key / index. A single-element list is equivalent to setting
 key_column. Required for ROW_CHECKSUM and ROW_COUNT modes (this or the
 deprecated key_column). Optional in AGGREGATE mode when group_columns
 provides the grouping key.

mode.description: Comparison mode controlling how source and target are compared.
mode.title: Reconcilation Mode

name.description: Unique machine identifier within the suite. Alphanumerics, hyphens, and underscores. May be a UUID.

reporting.description:
Reporting output configuration controlling how much detail is included
 in the audit log for mismatched rows.

setup.description:
Setup queries run before this specific reconciliation.
 Executes after suite-level setup but before data comparison.

source.description: Source dataset to compare from — the "expected" or "authoritative" side.

target.description: Target dataset to compare against — the "actual" or "replicated" side.

teardown.description: Teardown queries run after this specific reconciliation completes.

teardown_on_failure.description:
Whether teardown runs on failure for this reconciliation.
 When not set, inherits from suite-level teardown_on_failure.

title.description: Human-readable title. Displayed in reports. Defaults to name when not set.

window.description:
Time window for incremental comparison.
 When set, automatically provides a {{window_start}} template variable
 for filtering queries to a recent time range.

synq.agent.recon.v1.Reconcilation.title: Reconcilation

synq.agent.recon.v1.ReconcilationSuite.description:
ReconcilationSuite is the root configuration for a reconciliation suite.
 It defines template variables and one or more reconciliation scenarios
 that compare data between source and target databases.
 Database connections are configured separately and referenced by name.

annotations.description:
Suite-level annotations. Each annotation is a name with zero or more
 string values. Applied to the deployed suite asset and inherited by every
 reconciliation case under the suite. Merged with per-case annotations and
 deployment-level annotations at promote time — the final, deduplicated
 list is exposed on PromotedReconSuiteMetadata / PromotedReconCaseMetadata
 and surfaced to the rest of the SYNQ platform via EntityAnnotations.

description.description: Optional longer description of the suite's purpose.

ignore_setup_errors.description:
When true, logs setup query errors as warnings and continues execution
 instead of aborting the run. Useful when setup creates IF NOT EXISTS objects.

name.description:
Short machine identifier for the suite.
 Unique machine identifier for the suite, used as the stable key for tracking runs over time.
 Alphanumerics, hyphens, and underscores. May be a UUID.

reconciliations.description:
Reconciliation scenarios to execute.
 Each reconciliation compares data between a source and target dataset.

setup.description:
Setup queries run once before all reconciliations begin.
 Use for creating temp tables, loading fixtures, or preparing the environment.
 Queries execute in order; all connections run sequentially.

strict_time_references.description:
When true, time reference detection (e.g. NOW(), CURRENT_DATE, GETDATE()
 in queries) returns an error instead of a warning. Prevents non-deterministic
 queries that produce different results on each run.

teardown.description:
Teardown queries run once after all reconciliations complete.
 Use for cleaning up temp tables or restoring state.

teardown_on_failure.description:
Whether teardown runs even when reconciliations fail with infrastructure errors.
 When false (default), teardown is skipped on failure to preserve state for debugging.

title.description:
Human-readable title for the suite.
 Displayed in dashboards and reports. Defaults to name when not set.

variables.description:
Template variables for query interpolation via {{variable_name}} syntax.
 Values can be literal strings or template expressions:
   - Literal: "2026-01-01"
   - Time expression: "{{today - 30d}}", "{{now - 2h}}"
   - Built-in: "{{now}}", "{{today}}", "{{window_start}}"
 Variables are resolved once at the start of the run and frozen.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ReconcilationSuite.title: Reconcilation Suite

synq.agent.recon.v1.ReconciliationAudit.description:
ReconciliationAudit captures the configuration and runtime execution data
 for a single reconciliation.

columns.description: Column names discovered at runtime via QueryShape.

cutoff_result.description:
Cutoff resolution details (when cutoff was configured).
 Captures the derived watermark values, final cutoff, and WHERE clauses
 so the run can be fully understood and reproduced.

error.description: Error message if the reconciliation failed due to an infrastructure error.

normalization.description: Column normalization expressions applied after cross-DB type alignment.

original_source_query.description: Source query before variable interpolation (differs from suite query when variables are used).

overall_match.description:
Whether source and target matched overall.
 True when data matched exactly or differences were within configured thresholds.

source.description: Runtime dataset information (resolved queries, detected dialects).

status.description:
Outcome status of this reconciliation.
 Distinguishes infrastructure errors from data mismatches and threshold-based outcomes.
status.title: Reconciliation Status

synq.agent.recon.v1.ReconciliationAudit.title: Reconciliation Audit

synq.agent.recon.v1.ReportingConfig.description:
ReportingConfig controls the level of detail included in reconciliation output
 for mismatched rows. Higher detail levels reveal more data but may have
 privacy implications.

consent_acknowledged.description:
Explicit acknowledgment that detailed row data may be included in the audit log.
 Required when level is DETAILED to prevent accidental exposure of sensitive data.
 The caller must set this to true to confirm they understand the privacy implications.

level.description: Output detail level for mismatched rows.
level.title: Reporting Level

sample_limit.description:
Maximum number of sample rows to include in output per mismatch segment.
 Limits the size of the audit log when there are many mismatches.
 When not set, all mismatched rows within the reporting level are included.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ReportingConfig.title: Reporting Config

synq.agent.recon.v1.TableReference.description:
`name` is the table or view name (e.g., "orders", "fact_sales").
 `database` and `schema` are optional namespace qualifiers.
 The actual SQL FQN is generated at runtime using the appropriate dialect quoting.

columns.description:
Explicit list of columns to include in the comparison.
 When set, only these columns are selected from the table.
 Mutually exclusive with exclude_columns.

database.description:
Database/catalog name (e.g., "PROD_RAW", "my_project").
 Maps to: Snowflake database, BigQuery project, Databricks catalog.

exclude_columns.description:
Columns to exclude from the comparison.
 All columns except these are selected (resolved at runtime via table metadata).
 Useful for skipping volatile columns (e.g., updated_at, etl_batch_id).
 Mutually exclusive with columns.

name.description:
Table or view name (e.g., "orders", "fact_sales").
 Required — this is the actual object name.

schema.description:
Schema/dataset name (e.g., "public", "analytics").
 Maps to: Snowflake schema, BigQuery dataset, Databricks schema.

where.description:
Row filter — appended as WHERE clause to the generated SELECT.
 Example: "created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND status = 'active'"

synq.agent.recon.v1.TableReference.title:
TableReference specifies a table and optional column filtering.
 Use this instead of a raw query when you want to compare all (or most) columns
 of a table without writing SQL.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ThresholdConfig.description:
Thresholds can be overridden at finer granularity:
   - per_column: override thresholds for a specific group_column drill-down level.
   - per_measure: override thresholds for a specific measure (e.g., "SUM(amount)").
   - Nesting: per_column entries may contain per_measure overrides (most specific wins).

 When no thresholds are configured at any level, exact match is required.

absolute.description:
Maximum allowed absolute difference per measure.
 When set, differences <= this value are considered within tolerance.
 Example: absolute = 0.01 accepts sub-cent rounding differences.

per_column.description:
Per group_column level threshold overrides.
 Allows different tolerance for different levels of the drill-down hierarchy.
 For example, tighter thresholds at the city level than at the region level.
 Entries may themselves contain per_measure overrides for maximum specificity.

per_measure.description:
Per measure threshold overrides.
 Allows different tolerance for different measures within the same reconciliation.
 For example, allow 1% tolerance for SUM(amount) but require exact COUNT match.

percentage.description:
Maximum allowed percentage difference per measure.
 Expressed as a decimal fraction: 0.1 = 10%, 0.01 = 1%.
 The formula used depends on percentage_mode.
 When set, differences <= this percentage are considered within tolerance.

percentage_mode.description:
Which percentage formula to use for threshold evaluation.
 Only relevant when percentage is set.
percentage_mode.title: Percentage Mode

synq.agent.recon.v1.ThresholdConfig.title:
ThresholdConfig defines tolerance thresholds for aggregate comparisons.
 A difference is reported as a mismatch only when it exceeds ALL configured
 thresholds (AND logic: both absolute AND percentage must be exceeded).

synq.agent.recon.v1.ThresholdEvaluation.description: ThresholdEvaluation captures the effective thresholds applied and per-measure verdicts.

absolute_threshold.description: Configured maximum absolute difference, or 0 if not set.

percentage_threshold.description: Configured maximum percentage difference, or 0 if not set.

synq.agent.recon.v1.ThresholdEvaluation.title: Threshold Evaluation

synq.agent.recon.v1.WindowConfig.description:
WindowConfig defines a time window for incremental comparison.
 When configured, automatically provides a {{window_start}} template variable
 that resolves to (current_time - lookback). Use this in query WHERE clauses
 to limit comparison to recent data.

column.description:
Column being windowed.
 Informational metadata for the audit trail — the actual filtering is done
 via the {{window_start}} variable in your query WHERE clause.

lookback.description:
How far back to look from the current time.
 Defines the window as [now - lookback, now].
 Examples: "336h" (14 days), "2h", "720h" (30 days).

strategy.description: Windowing strategy controlling how boundaries are computed.
strategy.title: Window Strategy

synq.agent.recon.v1.WindowConfig.title: Window Config

synq.entities.v1.Annotation.description:
Annotations can be used to annotate any entity with a key:value pair.
 These annotations can be used for filtering and searching entities.

values.description: Optional list of values that the annotation can carry.
